title: Nightshift news item
description: One announceable (or not yet announceable) change. File name: docs/news/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.json, where the date equals `shipped`. tests/test_news_format.py is the validator of record: it checks everything below plus what a schema cannot express (script of each language, banned claims, lengths of the combined message, numbers that must match across languages).

pr.description: The pull request that shipped the change.

shipped.description: The date the change reached the live product (the merge/deploy date), not the date the text was written.

public.description: A human decided this may be announced. Only `true` makes a file announceable; the default for anything security-related is false.

text.description: Plain text, one short paragraph per language, no markup, no URL (the link goes in `link`). The same facts in all three languages.

link.description: A path on our own site, for example /pricing. The sender prefixes the site origin.

media.description: A hint for the owner about which picture or video would suit this item. Never a file; nothing is attached automatically.
